nodes.prompt:
Repo: falcon-event-tracking (Falcon Nexus: Next.js 16 dashboard in apps/dashboard over the shared BigQuery event table falcon-ecb55.product_analytics.events; pnpm workspace; vitest). Read first, in order: /Users/nguyentuan/Documents/second-brain/jobs/2026-10-13-nexus-feature-detail.md (Why + Decisions are binding), CLAUDE.md, apps/dashboard/AGENTS.md (Next 16 differs from your training data - check node_modules/next docs/types before using an API), apps/dashboard/src/app/(dashboard)/features/page.tsx and loading.tsx, apps/dashboard/src/lib/bigquery/queries.ts (getFeaturesData, appFilter, runQuery), src/lib/bigquery/events-query.test.ts (how runQuery is mocked), src/lib/i18n.ts, src/lib/docs-content.ts.

TASK feature-detail - the whole brief.
- Decision 1: a shared SQL fragment excluding payload.system rows, used by every usage query (features funnel + adoption, overview, MCP usage tools - grep for queries that count shops/events as usage); docs item updated.
- Decision 2: /features/[menu]/[card] page + getFeatureDetailData(appId, range, menu, card) with parameterised SQL; adoption table rows link to it carrying the current app/range; header numbers match the adoption row definitions; weekly trend; breakdown by action; failures; outcome section from system rows with payload.score (avg score per day; per failing_types item: shops failing at first scan in range vs no longer failing at latest, shops with >= 2 scans) with an empty state.
- Decision 3/4: follow existing patterns, en + vi strings, docs items, vitest tests with mocked runQuery, TDD.

Rules: touch only files in the contract allow list. TDD: failing test first, watch it fail. Comments say WHY only, never narrate WHAT. No new dependencies, do not touch lockfiles, .env*, CI config, Dockerfile, firebase.json. No secrets. Run every verify command yourself (from apps/dashboard: npx vitest run; npx tsc --noEmit -p .; npx eslint <changed files>). Final message: file:line per change and anything in the brief you could not do and why.
Known pre-existing failure on the base, not yours, excluded from verify: src/lib/mcp/tools/bugs.test.ts.

contract.goal: Nexus excludes payload.system rows from usage and has a per-card feature detail page with breakdown, trend, failures and score outcome

verify.name: eslint
cmd: F=$( { git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM origin/main -- "apps/dashboard/*.ts" "apps/dashboard/*.tsx"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- "apps/dashboard/*.ts" "apps/dashboard/*.tsx"; } | sed "s#^apps/dashboard/##" | sort -u); [ -z "$F" ] || (cd apps/dashboard && npx eslint $F)
